title: Two installs on one Tailscale machine share the machine link and invite with both locks
description: With only the tailscale command stubbed, up serves two fixture installs on their own ports (tailscale serve --bg --http=PORT), a rerun keeps the other install's route and a host without Tailscale carries on locally. Two served control planes on one simulated machine share the share link pasted on install A's Setup page; Invite someone on each copies one message with that link and its own URL and port. Invites redeem only on their own install, once, within 24 hours under a controlled clock; the link's 30-day expiry warns in its last seven days and refuses invites once expired; the optional API token is saved 0600, never shown, masked from confined sessions, and makes one single-use device invite through a fake Tailscale API, failing whole when Tailscale refuses. No Docker or Tailscale credentials.
